hypotheses: A positive rate penalty suppresses denoising-useful state information.
Fresh versus resumed rate removal tests dependence on learning history.
limitations: Beta zero removes both entry and surprise penalties; it does not isolate them.
The forecast-render branch still trains the predictor through pixel denoising.
Fresh/resume contrasts also differ in optimizer, data cursor and LR; they cannot prove an irreversible absorbing state.
Information recovery does not imply a usable latent goal metric or planning improvement.
These are diagnostic ablations, not a proposed new algorithm or an automatic long-run screen.
protocol.comparison: New paired controls, same initialization seed or exact full checkpoint, data, RNG, model size, scheduler horizon and 600 updates. Only beta differs within a pair.
protocol.next_review: Inspect complete state, gradients, state/region-use and trajectories. No automatic continuation; old held runs remain immutable.

review.decision: Hold all16 training endpoints. Rate removal does not restore TwoRoom feature variation in either initialization regime; investigate state-noise versus target-corruption channels via separately frozen600 gates. Evaluate all16 frozen endpoints with information audits, and all8 resumed endpoints on the existing50 validation cases. Fresh600 planning is not treated as mature performance.
